trends.label: AI in Fintech
trends.detail: The integration of AI in fintech is on the rise, with companies like Paytm and PolicyBazaar leveraging AI for personalized customer experiences. This trend matters for the candidate as it highlights the growing demand for AI product managers in the Indian fintech industry.

trends.label: Digital Banking
trends.detail: Digital banking is becoming increasingly popular in India, with banks like HDFC and ICICI investing heavily in digital transformation. This trend is crucial for the candidate as it emphasizes the need for product managers with expertise in digital banking and core banking migration.

trends.label: Conversational AI
trends.detail: Conversational AI is gaining traction in the Indian market, with companies like Google and Amazon investing in chatbot technology. This trend is relevant for the candidate as it highlights the growing demand for product managers with expertise in conversational AI and prompt engineering.

trends.label: Regulatory Compliance
trends.detail: Regulatory compliance is becoming increasingly important in the Indian fintech industry, with the RBI introducing new guidelines for digital lending and data protection. This trend matters for the candidate as it emphasizes the need for product managers with expertise in regulated environments and change governance.

trends.label: Cross-Geo Collaboration
trends.detail: Cross-geo collaboration is becoming increasingly important in the Indian tech industry, with companies like Wells Fargo and Citibank operating globally. This trend is crucial for the candidate as it highlights the need for product managers with expertise in cross-geo Scrum leadership and release management.

certifications.name: Certified Product Manager (CPM)
certifications.provider: Association of International Product Marketing and Management (AIPMM)
certifications.why: The CPM certification is valued by hiring managers in 2026 as it demonstrates expertise in product management and is recognized globally. It is particularly relevant for product managers in the fintech industry.

certifications.name: Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
certifications.why: The CSM certification is highly valued in the Indian tech industry as it demonstrates expertise in Scrum framework and is recognized globally. It is particularly relevant for product managers with expertise in cross-geo Scrum leadership.

certifications.name: Certified Data Scientist (CDS)
certifications.why: The CDS certification is highly valued in the Indian tech industry as it demonstrates expertise in data science and AI. It is particularly relevant for product managers with expertise in AI product building and prompt engineering.

certifications.name: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
certifications.provider: International Information Systems Security Certification Consortium (ISC)²
certifications.why: The CISSP certification is highly valued in the Indian fintech industry as it demonstrates expertise in information security and is recognized globally. It is particularly relevant for product managers with expertise in regulated environments and change governance.

certifications.name: Certified Fintech Professional (CFP)
certifications.why: The CFP certification is valued by hiring managers in 2026 as it demonstrates expertise in fintech and is recognized in the Indian industry. It is particularly relevant for product managers with expertise in digital banking and core banking migration.

news.headline: RBI Introduces New Guidelines
news.summary: The RBI has introduced new guidelines for digital lending in India, emphasizing the need for transparency and regulatory compliance. This development matters for the candidate as it highlights the growing importance of regulatory compliance in the Indian fintech industry.

news.headline: Paytm Launches AI-Powered Chatbot
news.summary: Paytm has launched an AI-powered chatbot to enhance customer experience and provide personalized support. This development is relevant for the candidate as it highlights the growing demand for conversational AI and prompt engineering in the Indian fintech industry.

news.headline: Google Invests in Indian Fintech
news.summary: Google has invested in several Indian fintech startups, including PolicyBazaar and ZestMoney. This development matters for the candidate as it highlights the growing interest of global tech companies in the Indian fintech industry and the need for product managers with expertise in AI and digital banking.
